body:
Retain the unit-5 AMOS overlap/countdown observations and AmiBlitz animation variants, with exact inputs, six compiler reports, source hashes and scoped limitations.

The audit includes the written plan, repeatable source/capture/built-listing verification, a rejected missing-toggle reasoning control, and isolated Chrome checks/screenshots at 390×844 and 1440×900. It records unsuccessful UI/browser attempts and short-click polling limitations. No frame-rate benchmark or learner-effectiveness result is claimed.

Part of code198x/website#776 and stevehill1981/198x#116. Coordinated with the website and code-samples `amiga-unit-five` PRs. The opening qualification in #99 stays separate.

Coordinated set: [samples #101](https://github.com/code198x/code-samples/pull/101), [lessons #778](https://github.com/code198x/website/pull/778), [evidence #100](https://github.com/code198x/docs/pull/100). Merge samples before lessons.
title: Retain Amiga unit-5 runtime and delivery evidence
